source: M.G.L. c. 4, § 7, cl. 18 (statewide legal holidays; a fixed-date holiday falling on a Sunday moves to the Monday). Dates computed from the statute's rules on 2026-11-01; the same computation reproduces the 2026 list, which was checked against the Secretary of the Commonwealth's published list. Check these against the Secretary's 2027 list, https://www.sec.state.ma.us/divisions/cis/holiday-info.htm, once it is published.
not_included: Evacuation Day (March 17) and Bunker Hill Day (June 17), which are legal holidays in Suffolk County only.
